# FREYA Revision 7 integrated website specification

The predecessor specification is preserved in archive/revision4_reassessment. All prior controls, ledgers, science options, power, impact, orbit, risks, requirements and exports remain present. Added panels cover effective inlet depth, 4 kg / 0.75 m conditional impact table, steel/CFRP structure and collar intrusion, radial series thermal resistance, entry angle and 401.6 MHz return-link margin. No calibrated rock penetration solver or flight optimum is claimed.

The integrated PDF preserves the 53-page Revision 6, predecessor peer review, depth study, updated material study, and historical entry reports in full. review.html provides complete integration text and all Revision 6 page text/links. New calculations and source manifests are downloadable under data/. Original source paper and supplementary documents are preserved in the companion evidence package.

Source precedence and every input boundary are described in the report. Tests compare website JavaScript with an independent Python implementation. Preserve existing hosting identity and public audience. No external data/API or AI service runs in the browser.
